description: Entry-type specific request parameters for the matrix model. Sent under `query.requestParameters`; each entry is an object keyed by entry type, as required by the Beacon framework `requestParameters` schema.

biosampleIDList.description: Comma-separated list of biosample IDs to filter expression values.

featureIDList.description: Comma-separated list of feature IDs to filter expression values.

order.description: Order results by cell quantification value (`asc` or `desc`); default is descending. There is no sort-by-id or expression.min/max.
